facts.business: Dhunseri Tea & Industries Limited is engaged in the cultivation, manufacture, and sale of tea from India and Malawi, along with macadamia nuts from Malawi and allied plantation services.
key_risks: Current liabilities exceed current assets by Rs. 6,601.21 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026, raising concerns about short-term liquidity and ability to meet liabilities as they fall due.
facts.related_party_note: All contracts/arrangements/transactions with related parties were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. No material transactions were entered during the year. Details are disclosed in Note No. 39 to the financial statements.
